about_the_game:
The world has been put on the "Brink of Broken" after Miduza cast a horrible spell, turning nearly all to stone! Monsters roam freely, and the threat of further petrification still lurks deep in hostile territory. As the last 'Fragment,' you are tasked with stabilizing the state of the world... a task that all before you failed.

Combat

The weapons you pick up will be at your disposal in turn-based battles. Shatter your enemies with heavy hitters that sacrifice defense or poison them and hide behind a wall of shields! Only be wary of their durability, lest you fail to land the lethal strike and become another broken weapon yourself!

Recruit additional party members to expand your total arsenal of weapons, opening up thousands of builds and boosting your survival. If anyone should reach 0 HP however, you will be defeated. Carefully manage who takes damage, and when, to claim victory in perilous encounters!

Exploration

As you traverse the world, you will find dungeons, power-ups, plenty of new weapons, and perhaps even a few secret rooms! All enemies are visible in the overworld, allowing you to pick and choose your battles. Weave through monsters to steal away treasures, or crush them all to prove your might!

Use everything at your disposal as you hunt down Miduza, and save the world from the brink!

Difficulty

Presets ranging from the peaceful "Easy" to the cruel "Broken" to fit various tastes and levels of experience. Can be swapped freely during gameplay!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2, or x86_32 CPU with SSE2
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Support for OpenGL 3.3
  • Storage: 150 MB available space

short_description: A turn-based RPG in a world already ruined! The weapons you pick up are plentiful but fragile, you must break your foes before your weapons shatter! Explore the land in search of permanent power-ups, or win your battles with strategy alone!
